description: Defines the ocudu::detail::byte_buffer_segment class, which manages a non-owning byte buffer divided into headroom, payload, and tailroom, with methods for manipulation such as append, prepend, resize, and trim.

classes.name: byte_buffer_segment
classes.description: Manages a segmented byte buffer with headroom, payload, and tailroom, providing methods for buffer manipulation.

methods.name: byte_buffer_segment()
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes an empty segment.

methods.name: byte_buffer_segment(span<uint8_t> buffer_, size_t headroom_)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the segment with a buffer and specified headroom, setting payload size to zero.

methods.name: capacity()
methods.description: Returns total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: empty()
methods.description: Checks if the payload is empty.

methods.name: headroom()
methods.description: Returns available space at the beginning of the buffer.

methods.name: length()
methods.description: Returns size of the payload.

methods.name: tailroom()
methods.description: Returns available space at the end of the buffer.

methods.name: back()
methods.description: Returns reference to the last byte of the payload.

methods.name: data()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the start of the payload.

methods.name: operator[](size_t idx)
methods.description: Index-based access to payload bytes.

methods.name: resize(size_t nof_bytes)
methods.description: Resizes the payload, uninitialized if larger.

methods.name: append(span<const uint8_t> bytes)
methods.description: Appends bytes to the tail.

methods.name: append(It it_begin, It it_end)
methods.description: Appends a range of bytes to the tail.

methods.name: append(uint8_t byte)
methods.description: Appends a single byte to the tail.

methods.name: prepend(span<const uint8_t> bytes)
methods.description: Prepends bytes to the head.

methods.name: reserve_prepend(size_t nof_bytes)
methods.description: Reserves headroom space.

methods.name: trim_head(size_t nof_bytes)
methods.description: Removes bytes from the head.

methods.name: trim_tail(size_t nof_bytes)
methods.description: Removes bytes from the tail.

methods.name: begin()
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of payload.

methods.name: end()
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of payload.
